procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic conversation, I verified the explicitly pinned input byte hashes and read packet.json, case.json, the rules, rubric, ratio policy and the three native-evidence manifests. I actually displayed and visually inspected each exact PNG using tools.view_image with detail='original', emitted through functions.exec, in nine separate calls in this order: R7-B02-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R7-B02-M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; R7-B02-M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine displays preceded the first transcription judgment, image score and set-diversity judgment. Native dimensions were independently read from PNG IHDR headers. No source assets or protected layouts are declared in the packet. First raw reads below were manually transcribed from the displayed native views after the complete viewing sequence; soft wrapping is retained. There was no genuine unresolved glyph/punctuation ambiguity and no revisit. I do not claim a runtime thread ID or a runner-provenance inspection; session_id remains null.

evidence.location: left streetscape and its pale simplified continuation, approximately x0–500/y0–1536
evidence.observation: The large streetscape and geometric counterpart are nonglyph, content-grounded imagery rather than type or backdrop texture.

content_form.location: left detailed street and pale simplified continuation
content_form.observation: The image makes an urban-observation/abstraction analogy, but reduces it to a generic pleasant street and simplified silhouettes. There is little specific visible organization of observations beyond geometric reduction; the visual argument for a practical data forum remains thin.

The image relates directly to the city theme, while the distinctions between everyday-data gaps, local mapping and team collaboration are supplied by text rather than developed by the nonglyph concept.

hierarchy.location: right column, from headline through location and schedule to orange links
hierarchy.observation: Large paired headlines lead to forum identity, date and venue, then a time-aligned agenda. Rules introduce audience and application blocks; the orange bilingual URL pair makes registration easy to locate.

hierarchy.location: upper right and full vertical text column
hierarchy.observation: The Korean title and English title remain recognizable anchors. Small supporting copy becomes miniature, but the agenda and registration group retain distinct positions.

typography.location: right column schedule and audience/application blocks
typography.observation: Hangul and English glyphs are clean and readable; timed rows keep Korean and English content associated. English continuations wrap under their Korean topic without dropping words. All 24 required entries compare equal under the declared rule.

typography.location: orange application lines and navy lower contact lines
typography.observation: Both protected URLs remain continuous and readable. The long English audience line is close to the right edge but remains intact; the reduction does not break the copy.

space.location: division between left urban illustration and right information column
space.observation: The pale intermediate forms provide a transition into the cream reading field. The title, metadata, agenda and lower utility groups share a stable left alignment and repeated rule width.

space.location: right lower third, audience through organiser
space.observation: Dense supporting information is divided by consistent gaps and horizontal rules. The organiser keeps a bottom margin, while the long audience line uses almost all available column width.

image_material.location: left tree, building entry and pavement
image_material.observation: Painterly leaf clusters, a solid trunk, window reflections and patterned pavement shadows create a coherent sunny streetscape; building and ground planes remain legible.

image_material.location: middle-left pale trees and blue pavement planes
image_material.observation: The reduction from detailed warm street forms to flatter cool silhouettes is consistently constructed. It reads as a deliberate paired image treatment, though the reduced forms carry limited data specificity.

emotion_control.location: whole poster, green canopy and orange entrance against navy type
emotion_control.observation: Bright foliage and warm building accents convey a lively, approachable city setting. Strong navy headings and ruled information give the forum a credible institutional tone without making it austere.
Orange directs energy toward the practical action of registering rather than competing with every line of supporting information.

ai_slop.observation: The repeated foliage belongs to the depicted street, and the pale forms repeat the adjacent city vocabulary. There are no observable pseudo-charts, arbitrary floating icons, invented logos or contradictory numerical claims.

ai_slop.location: agenda and lower bilingual utility groups
ai_slop.observation: Rules, time alignment and paired language lines form a consistent information system; no visibly corrupted glyphs or unexplained decorative labels interrupt it. The concept remains generic, as recorded separately in content_form.

residuals: The detailed-to-simplified street comparison provides only a broad observation/representation metaphor; it does not give the forum a strongly specific urban-data visual proposition.
The English audience line nearly fills the right column at usage size. Small logistics are not individually readable in the 320-pixel thumbnail, although their group structure survives.

content_form.observation: The hands and joined fields keep the observation/assembly analogy legible without making up map facts or numbers. The abstraction is specific enough to support the data forum, though it does not describe a particular analytic method.

hierarchy.location: top agenda, centred headline/metadata and bottom information cards
hierarchy.observation: Large dark/red bilingual title anchors the composition. Five ruled time rows make the programme easy to find; date and venue are paired under the title, and lower cards put audience and registration in stable positions.

hierarchy.location: title, urban assembly and two lower cards
hierarchy.observation: The title and joining-hands image survive the reduction as two clear focal anchors. Small event metadata and timetable details recede, while the two utility cards remain distinct shapes.

typography.location: top full-width programme rows and centred bilingual title
typography.observation: Hangul and English glyphs remain clear, with bold times and consistent bilingual row spacing. The compact English headline is tightly set but its words remain identifiable; all 24 required entries compare equal.

typography.location: two lower cards, blue URL/contact words and English audience wrap
typography.observation: Body copy and the protected application URLs are readable. English audience wraps across two lines without loss. Blue URL strings contrast against mint without broken slash or word spacing.

space.location: wide top programme band, centred identity and large middle visual
space.observation: The programme occupies a compact ruled band; a centred identity stack bridges it to the large urban pieces. The illustration has enough area to act as the visual centre rather than an icon added to a text poster.

space.location: yellow and mint cards in lower quarter
space.observation: Rounded cards have similar widths and internal padding, a consistent gutter, and enough clearance below the illustrated map edge to keep text intact. The top programme begins close to the upper edge, making that band denser than the lower cards.

image_material.location: hands, folded urban pieces and building/pavement details
image_material.observation: Outlines, planar shading and the isometric urban views share one illustrated language. Hands visibly grip the pieces; building steps, benches, tree planters and walking figures are legible and consistently scaled within the panels.

image_material.location: red join between yellow building field and mint public-space field
image_material.observation: The boundary carries through the adjacent panel edges as a purposeful join. The representation remains schematic, with enough local detail to identify urban activity and no assertion of a real map.

emotion_control.location: active hands, yellow/mint fields and red title word
emotion_control.observation: Holding and joining the city views creates a human, collaborative feeling. Saturated highlights make the event lively, while disciplined navy programme rows and metadata maintain trust.

emotion_control.location: lower paired cards and centred organiser
emotion_control.observation: Clear practical information tempers the playful illustration. The supplied organiser is legible without added institutional badges or sponsor logos.

ai_slop.location: urban panel details and the two gripping hands
ai_slop.observation: Trees, people, bench, lamps and building elements belong to the joined city views rather than floating as arbitrary motifs. The visible hands and folds read coherently, and the red boundary has a compositional function.

The rule system and bilingual associations are consistent. No pseudo-statistics, invented map legend, stray labels or visibly corrupted copy appear; the foliage repetition stays within the city scene.

residuals: The urban-data relationship remains an assembly metaphor rather than a depiction of a specific measurement or analytical method; the visible metaphor is sufficient for this open brief.

The programme has a shallow top margin, and the English headline is tightly set. Small date/venue/organiser details become miniature in thumbnail320; title, hands and card structure remain recognizable.

evidence.observation: A tall painted streetscape occupies the left half while one continuous information column occupies the right. Detailed versus pale simplified city forms distinguish its visual mechanism from M2’s architectural montage and M3’s hand-held assembly.

Rendered architectural slices surround a central title/programme, with metadata upper left and two lower utility columns. Its photographic material, framed central opening and distributed reading islands differ from M1’s vertical split and M3’s graphic assembly.

Large outlined hands join yellow/mint urban pieces below a top programme band and centred title, above two coloured cards. The joining action, illustration material and top/middle/bottom organization differ from the other two members.

residuals: All three share navy sans typography, cream reading fields, green urban vegetation and a sunlit built environment. Their material, nonglyph operation and composition change substantially, so the diversity is more than palette substitution, but the shared city imagery limits conceptual breadth.
